Hello!
What is your name?

sentences.chinese: 这是一个适合居住的好地方。

conversation_script.text_en: Hi, where are you from?
I am from China.
Which city are you from?

Do you live there now?
No, I live in Shanghai now.
Was Guangzhou your hometown?
Yes, I was born there.
Is it a big city?

conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,那是一个非常大的城市。

conversation_script.text_en: I would like to visit it someday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我希望有一天去那里参观。

conversation_script.text_en: You should. It is beautiful.
Thank you for sharing.
You're welcome.
Nice talking with you.
Nice talking with you too.

sentences.chinese: 这位游客是澳大利亚人。

conversation_script.text_en: Hello, where are you from?
I am from Guinea.
Oh, so you are Guinean?
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦,所以你是几内亚人吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, I am Guinean.
I am from China.
So you are Chinese.
That's right. Do you know people from other countries?
conversation_script.text_zh: 没错。你认识其他国家的人吗？

conversation_script.text_zh: 认识。我的同学有加拿大人、美国人和印度人。

conversation_script.text_en: That's interesting.

I have friends from France, Spain, and Korea.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有来自法国、西班牙和韩国的朋友。

conversation_script.text_en: Wow! That's international.
Yes, and I also know a German and an Australian.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,我还认识一位德国人和一位澳大利亚人。

conversation_script.text_en: It's great to meet people from different countries.
conversation_script.text_zh: 认识来自不同国家的人真棒。

conversation_script.text_en: I agree.
The world is a big place.

sentences.english: I can understand a little Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 让我们一起练习英语吧。

sentences.english: We are having a conversation in English.
I want to speak English fluently.

conversation_script.text_en: Hi, what languages do you speak?
I speak English and French.
That's great. Do you speak Chinese too?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了。你也会说中文吗？

conversation_script.text_en: A little. I am still learning.
I speak Chinese and English.
Can you speak French?
No, but I want to learn French.
French is a beautiful language.
conversation_script.text_zh: 法语是一门优美的语言。

conversation_script.text_en: Do you practice English every day?
Yes, I practice with my friends.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,我和朋友一起练习。

conversation_script.text_en: That's a good idea.
How often do you practice English?
I practice every day.
Your English will improve quickly.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你的英语会进步得很快。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you!
You're welcome.

My brother is older than me.

I am ten years old.
Really? I am eleven years old.
So you are one year older than me.

conversation_script.text_en: My birthday is in July.
That's nice. My birthday is in December.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真不错。我的生日在十二月。

conversation_script.text_en: Do you have a birthday party?
Yes, I do.
Who comes to your party?
My family and friends come.
That sounds fun.
Yes, we eat cake and play games.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,我们吃蛋糕和玩游戏。

conversation_script.text_en: I love birthday cake!
Me too!
Happy early birthday!

sentences.english: I am having a birthday party.
There is a big cake on the table.
Many guests come to my party.
sentences.chinese: 许多客人来参加我的聚会。
每个人都唱生日快乐歌。
我度过了一个美好的生日。

conversation_script.text_en: Happy birthday, Sarah!
Thank you very much!
How old are you today?
I am eleven years old now.
Are you having a birthday party?
Yes, my friends are coming this afternoon.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,我的朋友们今天下午会来。

conversation_script.text_en: Do you have a birthday cake?
Yes, it is a chocolate cake.
What is your birthday wish?
I wish for good health and happiness.
That's a wonderful wish.
Thank you.
I brought you a gift.
That's very kind of you.
Have a great birthday!
Thank you! Let's enjoy the party.
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢！让我们享受聚会吧。

sentences.chinese: 让我介绍一下我的朋友。

sentences.english: We have known each other for two years.
My friend speaks English and Chinese.
sentences.chinese: 我的朋友会说英语和中文。
每个人都喜欢我的朋友。

conversation_script.text_en: Hi Kevin, this is my friend Sarah.
Hello Sarah, nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too, Kevin.
Sarah is my classmate.
Really? Which class are you in?
We are in the same English class.
That's great.
Sarah is very kind and helpful.
conversation_script.text_zh: Sarah非常友善而且乐于助人。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you for saying that.
You're welcome.
Kevin, where are you from?
I am from Canada.
That's interesting.
I'm happy to meet new friends.
Me too.
Let's be friends.

sentences.chinese: 你的中文老师在这儿吗？

sentences.english: Is that tall person your friend?
sentences.chinese: 那个高的人是你的朋友吗？

sentences.english: Is the student inside the school now?
sentences.chinese: 现在学生在学校里面吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Hello! Are you a student?
Hello! Yes, I am a student.
Is he a student too?
No, he is not a student. He is a teacher.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不是，他不是学生。他是老师。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh, is he your Chinese teacher?
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦，他是你的中文老师吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, he is my Chinese teacher.

conversation_script.text_zh: 那边的那个女孩也是老师吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, she is a doctor. She is my friend.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不是，她是医生。她是我的朋友。

conversation_script.text_en: Is this small cat her cat?
No, that is not her cat.
Do you have a cat or a dog?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你有一只猫还是一条狗？

conversation_script.text_en: I have a big dog. Is that your dog outside?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有一条大狗。外面的那是你的狗吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, that big white dog is mine.
conversation_script.text_zh: 对，那条白色的大狗是我的。

conversation_script.text_en: It is very beautiful. Is it friendly?
Yes, it is very good. Let's go outside and see it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 对，它非常好。我们去外面看看它吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, let's go together.

sentences.chinese: 你最喜欢的食物是什么？

sentences.english: I am happy because it is my birthday.
sentences.chinese: 我很开心,因为今天是我的生日。

sentences.english: How do you go to school?
I go to school by bus.

sentences.chinese: WH问题帮助我们获取信息。

conversation_script.text_zh: 嗨,我可以问你几个问题吗？

What is your name?
My name is Kevin.

I am from Guinea.
How old are you?
I am twenty years old.

I speak English and French.

It is in September.

Because I want to make international friends.
conversation_script.text_zh: 因为我想结交国际朋友。

conversation_script.text_en: That's wonderful.
Thank you.

sentences.chinese: 简短回答让对话更容易。

conversation_script.text_en: Are you from China?
No, I'm not.
Are you from Guinea?
Yes, I am.

Yes, I do.

No, I don't.

Yes, I can.

No, I'm not.

Yes, I am.

sentences.english: Can you open the door, please?

sentences.chinese: 打扰一下,图书馆在哪里？

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, can you help me?
conversation_script.text_zh: 打扰一下,你能帮助我吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Of course.
Can you tell me where the bus stop is, please?
conversation_script.text_zh: 请问你能告诉我公交车站在哪里吗？

conversation_script.text_en: It's next to the bank.
Thank you very much.
You're welcome.
You are very kind.
Thank you.
Sorry, one more question.
Sure, go ahead.

Yes, there is one across the street.
Great! Thanks again.
No problem.
Have a nice day!
You too!

sentences.english: Excuse me, where is the restroom?
sentences.chinese: 打扰一下,洗手间在哪里？

sentences.chinese: 打扰一下,我可以坐这里吗？

sentences.english: Excuse me, can you help me?
sentences.chinese: 打扰一下,你能帮助我吗？
对不起,我忘记你的名字了。

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, is this seat free?
conversation_script.text_zh: 打扰一下,这个座位有人吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, it is free.
Thank you.
You're welcome.
Oh, sorry! I dropped my bag.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦,对不起！我的包掉下来了。

conversation_script.text_en: That's okay.
Excuse me, what time is it?
It's three o'clock.
Sorry, could you repeat that?
conversation_script.text_zh: 对不起,你能再说一遍吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure. It's three o'clock.
Thank you very much.
No problem.
Sorry, I need to leave now.
That's fine.
Have a nice day!
You too!

sentences.english: Can you say it more slowly?
How do you pronounce this word?

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, what did you say?
conversation_script.text_zh: 打扰一下,你刚才说什么？

conversation_script.text_en: I said my birthday is in September.
Sorry, can you repeat that?
conversation_script.text_zh: 对不起,你能重复一遍吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure. My birthday is in September.
Thank you. Please speak a little more slowly.
No problem. My birthday is in Sep-tem-ber.
conversation_script.text_zh: 没问题。我的生日在九月。

conversation_script.text_en: Now I understand.
Great!
How do you pronounce 'September'?
September.
Can you say it again?
September.
Thank you for your help.
You're welcome.
I will practice more.
That's a good idea.

sentences.english: Can you speak a little louder?
How do you pronounce this word?
Can you spell it for me?
Listening is important when learning English.
sentences.chinese: 学习英语时听力很重要。

conversation_script.text_zh: 我最喜欢的爱好是摄影。

conversation_script.text_zh: 对不起,你能重复一遍吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure. My favorite hobby is photography.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。我最喜欢的爱好是摄影。

conversation_script.text_en: Please speak a little more slowly.
My favorite hobby is pho-to-gra-phy.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我最喜欢的爱好是摄-影。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you. What does 'photography' mean?
It means taking pictures with a camera.
conversation_script.text_zh: 它的意思是用相机拍照。

conversation_script.text_en: I see. How do you pronounce it?
Photography.
Can you say it again?
Photography.
Can you spell it for me?
P-H-O-T-O-G-R-A-P-H-Y.
Great! Now I understand.
Excellent. Keep practicing!
I will. Thank you!

sentences.english: Can you give me an example?
Can you say that more clearly?
sentences.chinese: 你能说得更清楚一点吗？
练习帮助我更好地理解。

conversation_script.text_en: Today we will learn a new word: 'journey'.
conversation_script.text_zh: 今天我们学习一个新单词: journey。

conversation_script.text_en: Sorry, I don't understand.
No problem. 'Journey' means a trip from one place to another.
conversation_script.text_zh: 没关系。Journey 的意思是从一个地方到另一个地方的旅行。

conversation_script.text_en: Can you give me an example?
Sure. My journey from home to school takes thirty minutes.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。我从家到学校的路程需要三十分钟。

conversation_script.text_en: I see. What does 'takes' mean?
It means 'needs' or 'requires' time.
Can you say that more slowly?
Of course. It means it needs time.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。它的意思是需要时间。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you. I understand now.
Great! Do you have another question?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了！你还有别的问题吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, I don't.
Excellent. Keep practicing.
I will. Thank you for your help.
You're welcome.
See you next class.

sentences.chinese: 让我介绍一下我的同学。

sentences.english: Today is my first day here.
sentences.chinese: 今天是我来这里的第一天。

sentences.english: I am happy to meet new people.

sentences.chinese: 我们握手并做了自我介绍。

I'm from Guinea.

conversation_script.text_en: I would like that.
Do you have many students in this class?
Yes, everyone is very friendly.

Let's go inside together.

We have lunch in the afternoon.

I go to sleep at night.
The sun rises in the morning.
The sun sets in the evening.

Good afternoon! Nice to see you again.
sentences.chinese: 下午好！很高兴再次见到你。

Good morning, Sarah!
How are you today?
I'm great, thank you. And you?
I'm doing well.

They start at eight o'clock in the morning.
That's early.
Yes, it is.
Good afternoon, Sarah. How was your day?
conversation_script.text_zh: 下午好,Sarah。你今天过得怎么样？

conversation_script.text_en: It was busy but good.

I study English and read books.
That sounds nice.
Good night, Kevin.
Good night, Sarah. See you tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 我会说英语、法语和中文。
我最喜欢的爱好是阅读。
我很友好并且乐于助人。

sentences.english: This is some information about me.
sentences.chinese: 这是一些关于我的信息。

sentences.english: A short introduction is easy to remember.
sentences.chinese: 简短的自我介绍容易记住。

sentences.english: Five sentences are enough for a basic introduction.
sentences.chinese: 五句话足够完成一个基础自我介绍。

conversation_script.text_en: Hello everyone. Let me introduce myself.
conversation_script.text_zh: 大家好。让我介绍一下自己。

conversation_script.text_en: Please go ahead.
My name is Kevin.
I am from Guinea.
I live in Beijing.
I speak English, French, and Chinese.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我会说英语、法语和中文。

conversation_script.text_en: My hobby is reading books.

conversation_script.text_zh: 这是一个很好的自我介绍。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you.

I have been learning English for two years.
That's great.
I want to improve my speaking skills.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我想提高我的口语能力。

conversation_script.text_en: Keep practicing every day.
I will. Thank you for listening.
You're welcome.

conversation_script.text_zh: 你能从十一数到二十吗？

Eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen.

conversation_script.text_zh: 我们稍后再练习这些数字。

There are fifty chairs in the hall.
My grandfather is seventy years old.
Ninety birds flew over the lake.
One hundred is a big number.
Count by tens from twenty to one hundred.

sentences.chinese: 学习整十数有助于购物和数数。

Can you count to one hundred?
Yes, I can.
Great job!

sentences.english: Can you repeat your phone number?
sentences.chinese: 你能重复一下你的电话号码吗？

sentences.english: I use my mobile phone every day.
Can you text me your number?
sentences.chinese: 你能把号码发短信给我吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Hi Sarah, what is your phone number?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你好Sarah，你的电话号码是多少？

conversation_script.text_en: My phone number is 135-6789-4321.
Can you repeat that, please?
Sure. One three five, six seven eight nine, four three two one.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。一三五，六七八九，四三二一。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you. Let me write it down.
No problem.
Is this your mobile phone number?
Yes, it is.
I will save your contact.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我会保存你的联系方式。

conversation_script.text_en: Great. I will save yours too.
Can I send you a message later?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我稍后可以给你发消息吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Of course.
If I have the wrong number, please tell me.
conversation_script.text_zh: 如果我记错号码，请告诉我。

conversation_script.text_en: Sure, but I think it's correct.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然，不过我觉得是正确的。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you for your help.
You're welcome.

sentences.english: I want to buy a new bag.
She paid twenty yuan for lunch.
The total amount is fifty dollars.

sentences.chinese: 这个笔记本价值十五元。

sentences.english: He sells fruit at the market.

sentences.chinese: 学习价格表达有助于购物。

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, how much is this T-shirt?
It is twenty-five dollars.
That's not too expensive.
Yes, it is on sale today.
I would like to buy it.
Great. Anything else?
No, thank you.
The total is twenty-five dollars.
Can I pay with cash?
Of course.
Here is thirty dollars.
Thank you. Your change is five dollars.
Thank you very much.
You're welcome.
Have a nice day!
You too!

sentences.english: I am the first person in line.
sentences.chinese: 我是队伍中的第一个人。

sentences.english: He came third in the race.
sentences.chinese: 他在比赛中获得第三名。

sentences.english: My classroom is on the fourth floor.
Today is the fifth day of the month.
Her birthday is on the sixth of June.
My seat is in the eighth row.
He lives on the tenth floor.
Who is first in the competition?
The winner is in first place.
What is your position in the line?
sentences.chinese: 你在队伍中的位置是第几？

conversation_script.text_en: Who finished first in the race?
conversation_script.text_zh: 谁在比赛中获得第一名？

conversation_script.text_en: Tom finished first.
Who came second?
Sarah came second.
And who came third?
Kevin came third.
Great! What floor is your classroom on?
It is on the fourth floor.
What row do you sit in?
I sit in the third row.
What is today's date?
Today is the seventh of May.
Excellent! You know ordinal numbers well.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太棒了！你很会使用序数词。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you. I practice every day.
Keep up the good work!
I will. Thank you, teacher!

sentences.chinese: 星期一是第一个工作日。

sentences.english: I have English class on Tuesday.
My music lesson is on Thursday.

sentences.chinese: 星期五是我最喜欢的工作日。

sentences.english: There are seven days in a week.
Saturday and Sunday are the weekend.
sentences.chinese: 星期六和星期日是周末。

sentences.english: My schedule is busy this week.

conversation_script.text_en: What day is it today?
Today is Monday.
Do you have English class today?
No, my English class is on Tuesday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 没有，我的英语课在星期二。

conversation_script.text_en: What do you do on Wednesday?
I play basketball on Wednesday.
What is your favorite day of the week?
Friday is my favorite day.
conversation_script.text_zh: 星期五是我最喜欢的一天。

conversation_script.text_en: Why do you like Friday?
Because the weekend is coming.
What do you do on the weekend?
I visit my grandparents on Saturday and relax on Sunday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我星期六去看爷爷奶奶，星期日休息。

conversation_script.text_en: That sounds nice.
Yes, I enjoy the weekend.
Have a great week!
Thank you! You too!

sentences.english: January is the first month of the year.
sentences.chinese: 一月是一年的第一个月。
二月是一个较短的月份。

sentences.english: My sister was born in April.

sentences.chinese: 五月是我最喜欢的月份。

sentences.english: June is the sixth month of the year.
sentences.chinese: 六月是一年的第六个月。

sentences.english: The weather is cool in November.
December is the last month of the year.
sentences.chinese: 十二月是一年的最后一个月。

sentences.english: There are twelve months in a year.

conversation_script.text_en: How many months are there in a year?
There are twelve months in a year.
When is your birthday?
My birthday is in May.
Really? My birthday is in September.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真的吗？我的生日在九月。

conversation_script.text_en: That's nice. September is a good month.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真不错。九月是个好月份。

conversation_script.text_en: Which month do you like the most?
I like December the most.
Why do you like December?
Because there are many holidays.
What month is it now?
It is June.
June is a beautiful month.
conversation_script.text_zh: 六月是一个美丽的月份。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, I agree.
Let's practice all the months together.
conversation_script.text_zh: 让我们一起练习所有月份吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Great idea!

sentences.english: Her birthday is on the third of March.
My appointment is on the twenty-first of August.
There are many holidays in December.
Can you say the date in English?
I marked the date on my calendar.
sentences.chinese: 我在日历上标记了日期。

sentences.english: Learning dates is useful for daily life.
sentences.chinese: 学习日期对日常生活很有帮助。

conversation_script.text_en: What is today's date?
Today is June 15, 2026.
Can you say it another way?
Yes. Today is the fifteenth of June, twenty twenty-six.
When is your birthday?
My birthday is on May 8.
How do you say that in English?
May eighth.
When does school start?
School starts on September 1.
Is that September first?
Yes, that's right.
Are dates important?
Yes. We use dates for birthdays, meetings, and holidays.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的。我们用日期来表示生日、会议和节日。

conversation_script.text_en: I will practice writing dates every day.
Great idea!

sentences.chinese: 星期四是我最喜欢的一天。
星期五是一周工作日的最后一天。

sentences.english: I do not work on the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢的一天是星期日。

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! What day is it today?
It is Thursday today.
Oh, really? I thought it was Wednesday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦，真的吗？我以为今天是星期三。

conversation_script.text_en: No, look at the calendar. It says Thursday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不是，看日历。上面写着星期四。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you! Is tomorrow a weekday?
Yes, tomorrow is Friday. It is a weekday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，明天是星期五。是工作日。

conversation_script.text_en: What about Saturday? Is it a weekday?
conversation_script.text_zh: 那星期六呢？是工作日吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, Saturday is the weekend.
I like the weekend. What is your favorite day?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我喜欢周末。你最喜欢哪一天？

conversation_script.text_en: My favorite day is Sunday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我最喜欢的一天是星期日。

conversation_script.text_en: Why do you like Sunday?
Because I do not work on Sunday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 因为我星期日不用上班。

conversation_script.text_en: Yesterday was Wednesday, right?
Yes, yesterday was Wednesday.
Okay, I understand now. Thank you!
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，我现在明白了。谢谢！

conversation_script.text_en: You are welcome! Have a nice Thursday!
conversation_script.text_zh: 不客气！祝你星期四愉快！

sentences.chinese: 五月是一个温暖的月份。

sentences.english: The date is on the calendar.

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! What's the date today?
It is May 15th today.
May? What month is next?
Next month is June.
Is June hot?
Yes, June is warm. July is hotter.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，六月很暖和。七月更热。

conversation_script.text_en: What is your favorite month?
My favorite month is December.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我最喜欢的月份是十二月。

conversation_script.text_en: Why do you like December?
Because my birthday is in December.
conversation_script.text_zh: 因为我的生日在十二月。

conversation_script.text_en: What date is your birthday?
It is December 20th.
My birthday is in April.
April is a nice month. What date?
It is April 3rd. Let's look at the calendar!
conversation_script.text_zh: 四月三日。我们来看日历吧！

conversation_script.text_en: Okay! Here is the calendar. Happy birthday to us!
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的！这是日历。祝我们生日快乐！

sentences.english: What is the sum of four and five?
Yes, I can count to ten.
One hundred is a big number.

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! Can you help me with math?
Sure! What do you want to add?
What is one plus two?
One plus two equals three.
Okay! What about three plus two?
Three plus two equals five.
Great! Can you count to ten?
Yes! One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十。

conversation_script.text_en: Wow! What is five plus five?
Five plus five equals ten.
And ten plus ten?
Ten plus ten equals twenty.
What is zero plus four?
Zero plus four equals four.
I think I understand now. Thank you!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我想我现在明白了。谢谢！

conversation_script.text_en: You are welcome! Numbers are fun!
Hi! Can you help me with subtraction?
Sure! What do you want to subtract?
What is five minus two?
Five minus two equals three.
Okay! What about three minus one?
Three minus one equals two.
I have six apples. I eat two.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有六个苹果。我吃了两个。

conversation_script.text_en: How many apples are left?
Six minus two equals four. Four apples are left!
conversation_script.text_zh: 六减二等于四。还剩四个苹果！

conversation_script.text_en: Very good! What is ten minus four?
Ten minus four equals six.
Great! What is four minus four?
Four minus four equals zero.
And five minus zero?
Five minus zero equals five.
You are very smart! Subtraction is fun!

sentences.english: I have three groups of apples.

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! Can you teach me multiplication?
Sure! It is easy. What is two times two?
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！很简单。二乘二是多少？

conversation_script.text_en: Two times two equals four!
Very good! What about three times one?
Three times one equals three.
Great! Now, I have three groups of apples.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太棒了！现在，我有三组苹果。

conversation_script.text_en: How many apples in each group?
Each group has two apples.
What is the total?
Three times two equals six. Six apples total!
conversation_script.text_zh: 三乘二等于六。总共六个苹果！

conversation_script.text_en: I see! What is four times two?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我明白了！四乘二是多少？

conversation_script.text_en: Four times two equals eight.
And ten times one?
Ten times one equals ten.
Multiplication is fun! Thank you!
You are welcome! You are very smart!

sentences.english: Four divided by two equals two.
Six divided by three equals two.
What is eight divided by two?
Eight divided by two equals four.
Ten divided by two equals five.
I want to share with my friend.

sentences.chinese: 我们每人得到三块饼干。

sentences.english: Six divided by two equals three.
Four divided by four equals one.

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! Can you teach me division?
Sure! It means to share equally. What is four divided by two?
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！它的意思是平均分配。四除以二是多少？

conversation_script.text_en: Four divided by two equals two!
Very good! What about six divided by three?
Six divided by three equals two.
Great! I have six cookies. I want to share with you.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太棒了！我有六块饼干。我想和你分享。

conversation_script.text_en: How many cookies do we each get?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们每人得到多少块饼干？

conversation_script.text_en: Six divided by two equals three. We each get three.
conversation_script.text_zh: 六除以二等于三。我们每人得到三块。

conversation_script.text_en: The parts are equal! What is eight divided by two?
conversation_script.text_zh: 这些部分是相等的！八除以二是多少？

conversation_script.text_en: Eight divided by two equals four.
And what is half of ten?
Half of ten is five. Ten divided by two equals five.
conversation_script.text_zh: 十的一半是五。十除以二等于五。

conversation_script.text_en: What is four divided by four?
Four divided by four equals one.
Division is easy! Thank you!
You are welcome! Sharing is fun!

sentences.english: I have more apples than you.
You have less money than me.
How many more do you have?

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! Let's compare numbers!
Okay! Is five more than two?
Yes, five is more than two.
And is two less than five?
Yes, two is less than five.
What about ten and five? Which is bigger?
Ten is bigger than five.
And one and two? Which is smaller?
One is smaller than two.
I have five apples. You have two apples.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有五个苹果。你有两个苹果。

conversation_script.text_en: You have more apples than me!
Yes, and you have less than me.
What if we both have five?
Then we are equal. They are the same!
conversation_script.text_zh: 那我们是相等的。它们是相同的！

conversation_script.text_en: Comparing numbers is easy! Thank you!
You are welcome! You are very smart!

sentences.chinese: 四分之一等于百分之二十五。

sentences.english: I cut the pizza into two parts.
I cut the pizza into four parts.
One hundred percent is the whole.
Fifty percent is half of the whole.
sentences.chinese: 百分之五十是全部的一半。
百分之二十五是四分之一。

sentences.english: I want to share the pizza.
One third is about thirty-three percent.
sentences.chinese: 三分之一大约是百分之三十三。

sentences.english: The whole pizza is one hundred percent.
Can you divide it into parts?
sentences.chinese: 你能把它分成几部分吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! I have a whole pizza. Do you want some?
conversation_script.text_zh: 嗨！我有一个完整的披萨。你想吃吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! But what is a whole?
A whole is one hundred percent. It is everything.
conversation_script.text_zh: 全部是百分之百。是所有东西。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay! Can we cut it into two parts?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的！我们可以把它切成两部分吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure! Each part is one half. That is fifty percent.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！每部分是一半。那是百分之五十。

conversation_script.text_en: I see! What if we cut it into four parts?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我明白了！如果我们切成四部分呢？

conversation_script.text_en: Each part is one quarter. That is twenty-five percent.
conversation_script.text_zh: 每部分是四分之一。那是百分之二十五。

conversation_script.text_en: Wow! So four quarters equal the whole?
conversation_script.text_zh: 哇！所以四个四分之一等于全部？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! Four quarters equal one hundred percent.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！四个四分之一等于百分之百。

conversation_script.text_en: What about three parts? What fraction is that?
conversation_script.text_zh: 那三部分呢？那是什么分数？

conversation_script.text_en: That is one third. It is about thirty-three percent.
conversation_script.text_zh: 那是三分之一。大约是百分之三十三。

conversation_script.text_en: I understand! Half is fifty percent.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我明白了！一半是百分之五十。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! And quarter is twenty-five percent.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！而且四分之一是百分之二十五。

conversation_script.text_en: Can we share the pizza now?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们现在可以分享披萨了吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure! I get one half, and you get one half.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！我得到一半，你得到一半。

conversation_script.text_en: Fifty percent each! Thank you!

sentences.english: I want to buy two items.
Two dollars plus three dollars equals five dollars.
sentences.chinese: 两美元加三美元等于五美元。

sentences.english: The total cost is five dollars.
I need to pay five dollars.
One item costs one dollar and fifty cents.
sentences.chinese: 一个商品花费一美元五十美分。

sentences.english: Fifty cents plus fifty cents equals one dollar.
sentences.chinese: 五十美分加五十美分等于一美元。

sentences.english: The total price is ten dollars.

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! I want to buy some items. How much is this pen?
conversation_script.text_zh: 嗨！我想买一些商品。这支笔多少钱？

conversation_script.text_en: The price is two dollars.
And this notebook?
It costs three dollars.
So two dollars plus three dollars equals five dollars?
conversation_script.text_zh: 所以两美元加三美元等于五美元？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! The total cost is five dollars.
What about this eraser? How much is it?
It is cheap. Only fifty cents.
conversation_script.text_zh: 它很便宜。只要五十美分。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, I want the pen, the notebook, and the eraser.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，我想要这支笔、这个笔记本和这个橡皮。

conversation_script.text_en: Five dollars plus fifty cents equals five dollars and fifty cents.
conversation_script.text_zh: 五美元加五十美分等于五美元五十美分。

conversation_script.text_en: What is the total price?
The total is five dollars and fifty cents.
conversation_script.text_zh: 总计是五美元五十美分。

conversation_script.text_en: I have ten dollars. Do I have enough money?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有十美元。我有足够的钱吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! Ten dollars is more than five dollars and fifty cents.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！十美元比五美元五十美分多。

conversation_script.text_en: Great! I will pay now. Here is the money.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了！我现在支付。给你钱。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you! Here is your change. Have a nice day!
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢！这是你的找零。祝你愉快！

sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢的颜色是蓝色。
他最喜欢的颜色是绿色。

sentences.english: I have a red shirt and a black bag.
sentences.chinese: 我有一件红色衬衫和一个黑色包。

sentences.english: My favorite color is purple because it is beautiful.
sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢的颜色是紫色，因为它很漂亮。

conversation_script.text_en: What is your favorite color?
My favorite color is blue.
Do you have a blue shirt?
Yes, I do.
What color is your bag?
It is black.
I like black too.
Really? That is nice.
My car is white.
My car is red.
Red is a beautiful color.
conversation_script.text_zh: 红色是一种漂亮的颜色。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you. I like it very much.
Do you like green?
Yes, green is nice too.
Colors make things interesting.
I agree with you.

sentences.english: This is a light blue shirt.
sentences.chinese: 这是一件浅蓝色的衬衫。

sentences.english: That is a dark green bag.

sentences.chinese: 我的连衣裙是浅粉色的。

sentences.english: I wear a light green shirt today.
sentences.chinese: 我今天穿一件浅绿色的衬衫。

sentences.english: She has a dark red bag.

sentences.chinese: 你的连衣裙是什么颜色的？

sentences.english: My favorite color is light blue.
sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢的颜色是浅蓝色。

sentences.english: His favorite color is dark green.
sentences.chinese: 他最喜欢的颜色是深绿色。

sentences.english: The dark blue shirt looks nice.
sentences.chinese: 这件深蓝色衬衫看起来不错。

sentences.english: I like light pink because it is beautiful.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢浅粉色，因为它很漂亮。

sentences.english: Today I wear a light blue shirt and carry a dark green bag.
sentences.chinese: 今天我穿着浅蓝色衬衫，背着深绿色的包。

conversation_script.text_en: I like your shirt.
Thank you.
What color is it?
It is light blue.
Do you like light colors?
Yes, I do. They look beautiful.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的。我觉得它们很漂亮。

conversation_script.text_en: I like dark colors.
Really? What is your favorite color?
conversation_script.text_zh: 真的吗？你最喜欢什么颜色？

conversation_script.text_en: Dark green is my favorite.
That is a nice color.
What color is your bag?
My bag is dark red.
It matches your shirt well.
Thank you. I like this combination.
Colors are fun to learn.
Yes, they are everywhere.

sentences.english: Red and white look good together.
sentences.chinese: 红色和白色搭配很好看。

sentences.english: She wears a white shirt and black pants.
sentences.chinese: 她穿着白色衬衫和黑色裤子。

sentences.english: Green and yellow look nice together.
sentences.chinese: 绿色和黄色搭配很好看。

sentences.english: His shirt is blue and white.
sentences.chinese: 他的衬衫是蓝白相间的。

sentences.english: My dress is red and black.
sentences.chinese: 我的连衣裙是红黑搭配的。
这个搭配看起来很好看。

sentences.english: I wear a black shirt and white pants.
sentences.chinese: 我穿着黑色衬衫和白色裤子。

sentences.english: I like blue and white the most.
sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢蓝色和白色的搭配。

sentences.english: She wears a green dress with a yellow bag.
sentences.chinese: 她穿着绿色连衣裙，背着黄色包。

sentences.english: Black and white are a classic combination.
sentences.chinese: 黑色和白色是经典搭配。

sentences.english: Today I wear a blue shirt and black pants because they match well.
sentences.chinese: 今天我穿蓝色衬衫和黑色裤子，因为它们很搭。

conversation_script.text_en: I like your clothes.
Thank you.
What colors are they?
My shirt is white and my pants are black.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我的衬衫是白色的，裤子是黑色的。

sentences.chinese: 这个星形看起来很漂亮。

conversation_script.text_en: I like heart shapes.
They look very nice.
Can you find a square in this room?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你能在这个房间里找到一个正方形吗？

conversation_script.text_zh: 能，这个盒子是正方形的。

conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，我们每天都能看到它们。

sentences.chinese: 我们可以比较这两个包的大小。

Wow, it is very big.

Is your house big?

Do you have a big room?
I have a small room.
What about your car?

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, that is true.

The story is short and easy.
sentences.chinese: 这个故事很短而且很容易。

conversation_script.text_zh: 一根绳子长，一根绳子短。

Which rope is longer?
The blue rope is longer.

They are easy to read.

conversation_script.text_en: Learning about length is useful.

Let's take the wide road.
Why not the narrow path?
conversation_script.text_zh: 为什么不走那条狭窄的小路？

The wide road has more space.
Yes, it is more comfortable.
Look at that bridge.
It is very wide.
Can we cross it?

Our hallway is wide.
That sounds nice.
Yes, there is a lot of space.

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, and we can see them everywhere.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，而且我们到处都能看到它们。

conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢！我们现在去上课吧。

sentences.chinese: 你包里的东西是重还是轻？

sentences.chinese: 那个西瓜很大，所以它很重。

They are my new Chinese books.

conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢你，你真是个好朋友。

conversation_script.text_en: Is your computer inside this box too?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你的电脑也在这个箱子里吗？

conversation_script.text_zh: 没有，我的电脑在我的房间里。

conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了，那这个箱子还不是最重的。

conversation_script.text_zh: 你喜欢穿什么颜色的衣服？

conversation_script.text_zh: 我最喜欢蓝色的衣服。你呢？

conversation_script.text_zh: 哦，她旁边的那个人是谁？

conversation_script.text_zh: 好，我们也顺便看看衣服。

conversation_script.text_zh: 也许你能找到一件好看的蓝衬衫。

conversation_script.text_zh: 这个房间的窗户也是方形的吗？

conversation_script.text_zh: 桌子上的那些是什么？盘子吗？

conversation_script.text_zh: 对，那些 my 是我的新圆形盘子。

sentences.english: That blue shirt is a bit long for him.
sentences.chinese: 那件蓝色的衬衫他穿有一点长。

sentences.english: I want to buy a large size box for my books.
sentences.chinese: 我想买一个大号的箱子放我的书。

sentences.english: Please give me a smaller size to try one more time.
sentences.chinese: 请给我一个小一点的号再试一次。

conversation_script.text_en: Welcome to our shop! What do you want to buy?
conversation_script.text_zh: 欢迎去我们的商店！你想买什么？

conversation_script.text_en: Hello, I want to look at those black pants.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你好，我想看看那条黑色的裤子。

conversation_script.text_en: What size pants do you wear?
I usually wear a large size.
Okay, please try this large size on.
I feel these pants are too long.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我觉得这条裤子太长了。

conversation_script.text_en: Is it a bit big for you too?
conversation_script.text_zh: 对你来说也有一点大吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, it is not fit. Do you have a smaller size?
conversation_script.text_zh: 对，不合适。你有小一点的号吗？

conversation_script.text_en: We have a small size. Do you want to try it?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们有小号。你想试一下吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, please give me the small size.
Here you go. This one is shorter.
This small size fits very well. It looks good.
conversation_script.text_zh: 这个小号很合适。很好看。

conversation_script.text_en: Do you also want to look at shoes today?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你今天还想看看鞋子吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, thank you. These pants are enough.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不用了，谢谢。这条裤子就可以了。

conversation_script.text_en: Great, let's go over there to pay.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了，我们去那边放钱吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, thank you for your help.

sentences.chinese: 这个白色的杯子是我的。

sentences.english: Does blue shirt match black pants?
I think white matches any color.
sentences.chinese: 我觉得白色配什么颜色都行。

sentences.english: The white table and blue cups match.
sentences.chinese: 白色的桌子和蓝色的杯子很配。

sentences.english: Those red things look good together.
sentences.chinese: 那些红色的东西放在一块很好看。

sentences.english: What color matches this blue shirt best?
sentences.chinese: 什么颜色最配这件蓝衬衫？

sentences.english: I want to buy a black bag to match my shoes.
sentences.chinese: 我想买一个黑色的包来配我的鞋子。

sentences.english: Do you think this red cup matches that square table?
sentences.chinese: 你觉得这个红色的杯子配那个方形的桌子吗？

sentences.english: She put the white apples and red apples together on the round plate.
sentences.chinese: 她把白苹果和红苹果一块放在圆形的盘子里。

conversation_script.text_en: What color clothes are you going to wear today?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你今天想穿什么颜色的衣服？

conversation_script.text_en: I want to wear this blue shirt.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我想穿这件蓝色的衬衫。

conversation_script.text_en: Blue looks good on you. What about pants?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你穿蓝色很好看。裤子呢？

conversation_script.text_en: Do you think these black pants match?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你觉得这条黑色的裤子配吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, blue and black match very well.
conversation_script.text_zh: 配，蓝色和黑色在一块很合适。

conversation_script.text_en: Great. I also need to bring a bag.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了。我还得带一个包。

conversation_script.text_en: Look at that white bag. It matches your shirt.
conversation_script.text_zh: 看那个白色的包。它配你的衬衫。

conversation_script.text_en: You are right, white matches everything.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你说的对，白色配什么都行。

conversation_script.text_en: Let's put our things together in this bag.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们把东西一块放在这个包里吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay. Oh, look at that red cup on the table.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好。哦，看桌上那个红色的杯子。

conversation_script.text_en: It is my new cup. Does it look good?
conversation_script.text_zh: 那是我的新杯子。好看吗？

conversation_script.text_en: It looks good, but it doesn't match this blue table.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好看，但是它不怎么配这张蓝色的桌子。

conversation_script.text_en: Really? Then I will match it with a white plate.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真的吗？那我用一个白色的盘子配它。

conversation_script.text_en: That would look much better.
Thanks! You really know how to match colors.
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢！你真会看颜色搭配。

conversation_script.text_en: Haha, let's go, or we will be late for class.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哈哈，我们走吧，要不上课要迟到了。

sentences.english: The left side has a cat.
The right side has a car.
The person on the left is tall.
The person on the right is short.
He wears a white shirt in the picture.
There is a big square table on the left.
sentences.chinese: 左边有一张大的方形桌子。

sentences.english: What is that thing on the right side of the picture?
sentences.chinese: 照片右边的那个东西是什么？

sentences.english: I see a blue cup and many books above.
sentences.chinese: 我看见上面有一个蓝色的杯子和很多书。

sentences.english: This picture has a big house and a small car below.
sentences.chinese: 这张照片下面有一个大房子和一辆小汽车。

sentences.english: The tall teacher on the right side is wearing a red shirt today.
sentences.chinese: 右边那个高个子老师今天穿了一件红衬衫。

conversation_script.text_en: Look at this picture. It is very beautiful.
Yes, there are many people in this picture.
conversation_script.text_zh: 对，这张照片里有很多人。

conversation_script.text_en: Who is the tall person on the left side?
That is my big brother. He wears a blue shirt.
conversation_script.text_zh: 那是我哥哥。他穿蓝衬衫。

conversation_script.text_en: He looks very nice. Who is below him?
conversation_script.text_zh: 他看起来很好。他下面是谁？

conversation_script.text_en: Below him is our small white dog.
conversation_script.text_zh: 他下面是我们的小白狗。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh, I see it now. It is very small.
Yes, it is smaller than the cat on the right.
conversation_script.text_zh: 对，它比右边的猫还要小。

conversation_script.text_en: Is that short girl on the right your sister?
conversation_script.text_zh: 右边那个矮的女孩是你妹妹吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, she wears a red shirt in this picture.
conversation_script.text_zh: 对，她在照片里穿一件红衬衫。

conversation_script.text_en: What is that above her head?
That is a big round clock on the wall.
conversation_script.text_zh: 那来是墙上一个大的圆形钟。

conversation_script.text_en: There is also a square table on the left side.
conversation_script.text_zh: 左边也有一张方形的桌子。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, there are many books above that table.
conversation_script.text_zh: 对，那张桌子上面有很多书。

conversation_script.text_en: I really like this picture of your family.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我真喜欢你家人的这张照片。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you, let's look at another one now.
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢你，我们现在看另外一张吧。

sentences.english: The book is in the bag.
The phone is on the table.
The cat is under the chair.
Your pen is on the bed.
The box is under the table.
Is the book in the box?
Yes, it is on the chair.
No, it is under the bed.
The keys are on the table, not under the chair.
sentences.chinese: 钥匙在桌子上，不在椅子下面。

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! Where is my phone?
Is it in your bag?
No, it is not in my bag.
Look! It is on the table.
Oh, yes! And where is my book?
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦，是的！那我的书在哪里？

conversation_script.text_en: Is it under the chair?
No, it is not there.
Here! It is in the box, under the bed.
conversation_script.text_zh: 这里！它在床下面的盒子里。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you! And where are you now?
I am in my room. I am on the bed!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我在我的房间里。我在床上！

conversation_script.text_en: Haha! Is your cat with you?
conversation_script.text_zh: 哈哈！你的猫和你在一起吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, it is under the bed. It sleeps there.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，它在床下面。它在那里睡觉。

conversation_script.text_en: Nice! My cat is on the chair in the living room.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真好！我的猫在客厅的椅子上。

conversation_script.text_en: Cats love to sleep in, on, and under things!
conversation_script.text_zh: 猫喜欢在里面、上面和下面睡觉！

conversation_script.text_en: That is true! See you later!
See you! Do not put your phone under the table!
conversation_script.text_zh: 回头见！别把你的手机放在桌子下面！

sentences.english: The dog is behind the door.
The car is in front of the house.
The tree is in front of my window.
Look! A cat is behind the car.
I stand in front of the door.
My friend waits behind the tree.
sentences.chinese: 我的朋友在树后面等着。

sentences.english: Yes, it is in front of the house.
No, it is behind the door.
The park is in front of the school.
I stand in front of the window.
The dog runs behind the house and sits in front of the tree.
sentences.chinese: 狗跑到房子后面，然后坐在树前面。

conversation_script.text_en: Hey! Where are you? I cannot see you!
conversation_script.text_zh: 嘿！你在哪里？我看不到你！

conversation_script.text_en: I am behind the big tree in the park.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我在公园里那棵大树后面。

conversation_script.text_en: Which tree? I am in front of the school now.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哪棵树？我现在在学校前面。

conversation_script.text_en: Look! The tree is in front of the school. I am behind it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 看！那棵树在学校前面。我在它后面。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh, I see! Wait, is your dog with you?
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦，我看到了！等等，你的狗和你在一起吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, but it runs behind the house now.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，但是它现在跑到房子后面去了。

conversation_script.text_en: My car is in front of the house. Is the dog behind my car?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我的汽车在房子前面。狗在我的汽车后面吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, it is in front of your car. It sits there.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不，它在你的汽车前面。它坐在那里。

conversation_script.text_en: Haha! I see it now. It is very cute.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哈哈！我现在看到它了。它很可爱。

conversation_script.text_en: Come here! I stand in front of the tree.
OK! But where is my bag? I cannot find it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的！但是我的包在哪里？我找不到它。

conversation_script.text_en: Is it behind the door of your house?
No, it is not there. Oh! It is in front of the window.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不，它不在那里。哦！它在窗户前面。

conversation_script.text_en: Great! Now come to the park. I am still behind the tree.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了！现在来公园。我还在树后面。

conversation_script.text_en: I am coming! Do not hide behind the tree!
OK! I stand in front of it now. I wait for you here!
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的！我现在站在树前面。我在这里等你！

sentences.english: The lamp is next to the sofa.
The picture is between the clock and the plant.
sentences.chinese: 照片在时钟和植物中间。

sentences.english: I live next to the school.
The cup is between the book and the phone.
Put the lamp between the two desks.
sentences.chinese: 把台灯放在两张书桌中间。

sentences.english: The clock is on the wall, next to the picture.
sentences.chinese: 时钟在墙上，在照片旁边。

sentences.english: My house is between the park and the shop.
sentences.chinese: 我的房子在公园和商店中间。

sentences.english: Is the plant next to the window?
Yes, it is between the sofa and the window.
sentences.chinese: 是的，它在沙发和窗户中间。

sentences.english: No, it is next to the door.
It is between the wall and the bed.
The shop is close to my house, next to the big tree between the park and the school.
sentences.chinese: 商店离我家很近，在公园和学校中间那棵大树旁边。

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! I am in your room. Where do I sit?
conversation_script.text_zh: 嗨！我在你的房间里。我坐哪里？

conversation_script.text_en: Sit next to me on the sofa.
OK. Where is your new lamp?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的。你的新台灯在哪里？

conversation_script.text_en: Look! It is between the two pictures on the wall.
conversation_script.text_zh: 看！它在墙上两张照片中间。

conversation_script.text_en: Nice! And where is the plant?
It is next to the desk, between the window and the sofa.
conversation_script.text_zh: 它在书桌旁边，在窗户和沙发中间。

conversation_script.text_en: I like it. Where do you live? Is it close to here?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我喜欢它。你住在哪里？离这里近吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, I live next to the park. It is between the school and the shop.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，我住在公园旁边。它在学校和商店中间。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh, I know that place! My friend lives there too.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦，我知道那个地方！我的朋友也住在那里。

conversation_script.text_en: Really? Which house? The one between the two big trees?
conversation_script.text_zh: 真的吗？哪座房子？在两棵大树中间的那座吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, her house is next to the shop, not between the trees.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不，她的房子在商店旁边，不在树中间。

conversation_script.text_en: I see. Put your cup on the table next to the clock.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我明白了。把你的杯子放在时钟旁边的桌子上。

conversation_script.text_en: OK. Where is my phone? Is it between the books?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的。我的手机在哪里？它在书中间吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, it is next to the lamp on the small desk.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不，它在小书桌上的台灯旁边。

conversation_script.text_en: Found it! Your room is very nice. Everything is close and easy to find.
conversation_script.text_zh: 找到了！你的房间很漂亮。所有东西都很近，很容易找到。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you! Next time, sit between me and the plant!
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢你！下次，坐在我和植物中间！

sentences.english: My home is near the school.
The hospital is far from here.
How far is your work from home?
It is near, only five minutes by walk.
The bus stop is not far from my house.
I walk to school because it is near.
sentences.chinese: 我走路去学校，因为它很近。

sentences.english: She drives to work because it is far.
sentences.chinese: 她开车去上班，因为很远。

sentences.english: Yes, it is very near, just there.
No, it is far, three kilometers from here.
sentences.chinese: 不，很远，离这里有三公里。

sentences.english: How far is the park from your home?
It is near, I walk there every day.
sentences.chinese: 很近，我每天走路去那里。

sentences.english: The school is far from the hospital.
I live near the bus stop, so it is easy to go to work.
sentences.chinese: 我住在公交车站附近，所以上班很方便。

sentences.english: My friend's house is far from here, but the shop near my home is close to her house.
sentences.chinese: 我朋友家离这里很远，但是我家附近的商店离她家很近。

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! Do you live near here?
Yes, my home is near the school. It is only two minutes from here.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，我家在学校附近。离这里只有两分钟。

conversation_script.text_en: Nice! How far is your work from home?
conversation_script.text_zh: 真好！你的工作离家多远？

conversation_script.text_en: It is far, about ten kilometers. I drive to work.
conversation_script.text_zh: 很远，大约十公里。我开车去上班。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh, that is far. Is there a bus stop near your home?
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦，那很远。你家附近有公交车站吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, but the bus stop is far from my work. I still need to drive.
conversation_script.text_zh: 有，但是公交车站离我的工作很远。我还是得开车。

conversation_script.text_en: I walk to work because it is near, only fifteen minutes.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我走路去上班，因为很近，只要十五分钟。

conversation_script.text_en: Lucky you! Is the hospital near your work?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你真幸运！医院离你的工作近吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, it is far from here, about five kilometers.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不，离这里很远，大约五公里。

conversation_script.text_en: How far is the park from your home? I want to go there.
conversation_script.text_zh: 公园离你家多远？我想去那里。

conversation_script.text_en: It is very near, just next to my house. We can walk there.
conversation_script.text_zh: 非常近，就在我家旁边。我们可以走路去。

conversation_script.text_en: Great! Is there a shop near the park?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了！公园附近有商店吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, there is one near the bus stop, not far from the park.
conversation_script.text_zh: 有，公交车站附近有一家，离公园不远。

conversation_script.text_en: Perfect! I live far from the city, so everything is far for me.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太棒了！我住在离城市很远的地方，所以对我来说所有东西都很远。

conversation_script.text_en: But your home is near nature, that is nice too!
conversation_script.text_zh: 但是你家靠近大自然，那也很好啊！

conversation_script.text_en: True! Next time, I will walk from my home to your home. How far is it?
conversation_script.text_zh: 没错！下次，我会从我家走路去你家。有多远？

sentences.english: The light is above the table.
The cat is below the shelf.
Look up! The airplane is above us.
sentences.chinese: 抬头看！飞机在我们上方。

sentences.english: Look down! The river is below the bridge.
The sign is above the door.
The floor is below my feet.
The ceiling is above the bed.
Is the shelf above the desk?
Yes, it is above the desk, near the ceiling.
sentences.chinese: 是的，它在书桌上方，靠近天花板。

sentences.english: No, it is below the window.
The bridge is above the river.
The city is below sea level.
sentences.chinese: 这座城市在海平面下方。

sentences.english: The airplane flies above the clouds, and the birds fly below it near the bridge above the river.
sentences.chinese: 飞机在云层上方飞，鸟在它下方靠近河上的桥附近飞。

conversation_script.text_en: Hey, look up! What is that above the building?
conversation_script.text_zh: 嘿，抬头看！那栋建筑上方是什么？

conversation_script.text_en: It is an airplane! It flies very high above us.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是一架飞机！它飞得比我们高很多。

conversation_script.text_en: Cool! And look down, what is below the bridge?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太酷了！再低头看，桥下方是什么？

conversation_script.text_en: The river is below the bridge. It is very beautiful.
conversation_script.text_zh: 河在桥下方。它非常美丽。

conversation_script.text_en: I see. Is your room above the shop?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我明白了。你的房间在商店上方吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, I live above the shop. My floor is below another room.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，我住在商店上方。我的地板在另一个房间下方。

conversation_script.text_en: So someone lives above you? Is the ceiling high?
conversation_script.text_zh: 所以有人住在你上方？天花板高吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, the ceiling is above my head. It is not low.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，天花板在我头上方。不低。

conversation_script.text_en: Where is the light in your room? Is it above the bed?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你房间里的灯在哪里？在床上方吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, it is above the shelf, below the ceiling.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不，它在架子上方，天花板下方。

conversation_script.text_en: I see. Look down again! Are there fish below the water?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我明白了。再低头看！水下方有鱼吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, they swim below the bridge, near the river floor.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，它们在桥下方游，靠近河底。

conversation_script.text_en: Nice! The sign above the door says 'No Fish'.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真好！门上方的标志写着'禁止钓鱼'。

conversation_script.text_en: Haha, that sign is above the shop door, not here!
conversation_script.text_zh: 哈哈，那个标志在商店门上方，不在这里！

conversation_script.text_en: Oh! I always look up and down. I love things above and below me!
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦！我总是抬头看和低头看。我喜欢我上方和下方的东西！

conversation_script.text_en: Me too! But do not fall down when you look up at the sky above!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是！但是当你抬头看上方天空的时候，别摔倒！

sentences.english: It is warm inside the house.
Please come in. It is nice inside.
I want to go out. The sun is outside.
The cat is inside the box.
The dog is outside the door.
Close the window. It is cold outside.
Open the door. I want to go outside.
Yes, stay inside. Do not go out.
No, the weather is good. We can play outside.
sentences.chinese: 不，天气很好。我们可以在外面玩。

sentences.english: Take your coat. It is cold outside but warm inside.
sentences.chinese: 带上你的外套。外面冷但是里面暖和。

sentences.english: My shoes are inside the house, not outside.
sentences.chinese: 我的鞋子在房子里面，不在外面。

sentences.english: The children play outside when the sun is out.
sentences.chinese: 太阳出来的时候，孩子们在外面玩。

sentences.english: I like to stay inside when it rains, but I love to walk outside when the sun is warm and the birds sing outside my window.
sentences.chinese: 下雨的时候我喜欢待在里面，但是当太阳暖和、鸟儿在我窗外唱歌的时候，我喜欢在外面散步。

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! It is cold outside today. Come in!
Thank you! It is very warm inside your house.
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢！你房子里面很暖和。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, stay inside. The weather is bad outside.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，待在里面。外面天气不好。

conversation_script.text_en: Is it raining outside? I want to go out later.
conversation_script.text_zh: 外面在下雨吗？我想晚点出去。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, it is raining. Do not go outside now.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，在下雨。现在别去外面。

conversation_script.text_en: OK, I will stay inside. But where is my coat?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，我会待在里面。但是我的外套在哪里？

conversation_script.text_en: It is inside the closet, near the door.
And my shoes? Are they outside?
conversation_script.text_zh: 那我的鞋子呢？它们在外面吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, they are inside, under the bed.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不，它们在里面，在床下面。

conversation_script.text_en: Good. When can we go outside?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的。我们什么时候可以去外面？

conversation_script.text_en: When the sun comes out. Then we can play outside.
conversation_script.text_zh: 等太阳出来的时候。然后我们可以在外面玩。

conversation_script.text_en: I love the sun! I want to sit outside and feel warm.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我喜欢太阳！我想坐在外面感受温暖。

conversation_script.text_en: Me too. But now, close the window. The rain comes inside.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是。但是现在，关上窗户。雨要进来了。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh no! I will close it now. The floor is wet inside.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦不！我现在就去关上。里面的地板湿了。

conversation_script.text_en: It is OK. We are safe and dry inside here.
conversation_script.text_zh: 没关系。我们在这里安全又干爽。

conversation_script.text_en: True! But later, I will run outside and jump in the sun!
conversation_script.text_zh: 没错！但是晚点，我要跑出去，在阳光下跳！

sentences.english: Turn right at the traffic light.
My left hand holds the book.
My right hand writes with a pen.
The shop is on the left side of the street.
The school is on the right side of the building.
Which hand do you use to write?
The elevator is on the left, and the stairs are on the right.
sentences.chinese: 电梯在左边，楼梯在右边。

sentences.english: Is the bank on the left or the right?
It is on the left, next to the corner.
Turn right, then go straight. The park is on the left.
sentences.chinese: 向右转，然后直走。公园在左边。

sentences.english: Hold the cup in your left hand and write with your right hand.
sentences.chinese: 用左手拿着杯子，用右手写字。

sentences.english: Go straight down this street, turn left at the big building, then turn right at the corner, and the shop is on your left side.
sentences.chinese: 沿着这条街直走，在大建筑物处向左转，然后在拐角处向右转，商店就在你的左边。

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, where is the bank? I need to find it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 打扰一下，银行在哪里？我需要找到它。

conversation_script.text_en: Go straight, then turn left at the corner.
conversation_script.text_zh: 直走，然后在拐角处向左转。

conversation_script.text_en: Left? Are you sure? I think it is on the right.
conversation_script.text_zh: 左边？你确定吗？我觉得它在右边。

conversation_script.text_en: No, turn left. The bank is on the left side of the street.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不，向左转。银行在街道的左边。

conversation_script.text_en: OK, thank you! Which side is the school on?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，谢谢！学校在哪个方向？

conversation_script.text_en: The school is on the right side, next to the big building.
conversation_script.text_zh: 学校在右边，靠近那栋大建筑物。

conversation_script.text_en: I see. Is the elevator on the left or right in that building?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我明白了。那栋楼里的电梯在左边还是右边？

conversation_script.text_en: The elevator is on the left, and the stairs are on the right.
conversation_script.text_zh: 电梯在左边，楼梯在右边。

conversation_script.text_en: Good to know. Which hand do you write with?
conversation_script.text_zh: 知道了。你用哪只手写字？

conversation_script.text_en: I write with my right hand. I hold my phone in my left hand.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我用右手写字。我用左手拿着手机。

conversation_script.text_en: Same here! Now, turn right here, yes?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是！现在，在这里向右转，对吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, turn left! Then go straight. The shop is on your right.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不，向左转！然后直走。商店在你的右边。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh, I always mix up left and right!
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦，我总是把左边和右边搞混！

conversation_script.text_en: Haha, look at your hands. You write with the right one.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哈哈，看看你的手。你用右手写字。

conversation_script.text_en: Right! Now I remember. Left is the other hand!
conversation_script.text_zh: 对！现在我想起来了。左边是另一只手！

conversation_script.text_en: Exactly! Now turn left, and we will find the bank on the left side!
conversation_script.text_zh: 没错！现在向左转，我们会在左边找到银行！

sentences.english: I live upstairs, on the second floor.
My friend lives downstairs, on the first floor.
sentences.chinese: 我的朋友住在楼下，在一楼。

sentences.english: Please go upstairs. My room is there.
sentences.chinese: 请上楼。我的房间在那里。

sentences.english: My neighbor upstairs is very loud.
I sleep downstairs because it is cool.
sentences.chinese: 我在楼下睡觉，因为很凉快。

sentences.english: Do you live upstairs or downstairs?
I live upstairs, in apartment two-oh-four.
The bathroom is downstairs, next to the kitchen.
sentences.chinese: 浴室在楼下，在厨房旁边。

sentences.english: Someone knocks on the door upstairs.
I wake up because the noise from upstairs is too loud.
sentences.chinese: 我醒来是因为楼上的噪音太大了。

sentences.english: Move your things upstairs. The first floor is full.
sentences.chinese: 把你的东西搬到楼上。一楼满了。

sentences.english: My bedroom is upstairs on the second floor, but I like to read downstairs because it is quiet and my neighbor upstairs does not make noise during the day.
sentences.chinese: 我的卧室在楼上二楼，但是我喜欢在楼下看书，因为很安静，而且我楼上的邻居白天不制造噪音。

conversation_script.text_en: Hey! Do you live in this building?
Yes, I live upstairs, on the second floor.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，我住在楼上，在二楼。

conversation_script.text_en: Nice! I live downstairs, on the first floor. We are neighbors!
conversation_script.text_zh: 真好！我住在楼下，在一楼。我们是邻居！

conversation_script.text_en: Really? I am sorry. Is the noise from upstairs too loud?
conversation_script.text_zh: 真的吗？对不起。楼上的噪音是不是太大了？

conversation_script.text_en: Sometimes, yes. Last night, I could not sleep.
conversation_script.text_zh: 有时候是的。昨晚，我睡不着。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh no! I am very sorry. I will move my things downstairs.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦不！非常抱歉。我会把我的东西搬到楼下。

conversation_script.text_en: No, it is OK. Just be quiet after ten o'clock.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不，没关系。只要十点后安静一点就好。

conversation_script.text_en: I will! Do you want to come upstairs? My apartment is nice.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我会的！你想上楼来吗？我的公寓很漂亮。

conversation_script.text_en: Sure! But first, I need to go downstairs. I left my keys there.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！但是首先，我需要下楼。我把钥匙落在那里了。

conversation_script.text_en: OK, I will wait here. Is the bathroom upstairs or downstairs?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，我在这里等。浴室在楼上还是楼下？

conversation_script.text_en: It is downstairs, next to the kitchen. Very easy to find.
conversation_script.text_zh: 在楼下，在厨房旁边。很容易找到。

conversation_script.text_en: Thanks! I will go downstairs first, then come upstairs to your room.
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢！我先下楼，然后上楼去你的房间。

conversation_script.text_en: Wait, someone knocks on the door upstairs. Is that your friend?
conversation_script.text_zh: 等等，有人在楼上敲门。是你的朋友吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! She lives upstairs too, on the third floor.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！她也住在楼上，在三楼。

conversation_script.text_en: This building is full of people upstairs! But downstairs is quiet.
conversation_script.text_zh: 这栋楼楼上住满了人！但是楼下很安静。

conversation_script.text_en: Haha, true! Come on, let's go upstairs together. We can be loud up there!
conversation_script.text_zh: 哈哈，没错！来吧，我们一起上楼。我们可以在那里大声点！

sentences.english: I lost my bag. I cannot find it.
sentences.chinese: 我的包丢了。我找不到它。

sentences.english: Where did you last see it?
sentences.chinese: 你最后一次在哪里看到它？

sentences.english: I look for it everywhere in my room.
Maybe it is in another place.
Do you remember where you put it?
sentences.chinese: 你记得你把它放在哪里了吗？

sentences.english: I think I left it on the bus.
sentences.chinese: 我想我把它落在公交车上了。

sentences.english: Check your room again. It is still there.
sentences.chinese: 再检查一下你的房间。它还在那里。

sentences.english: I checked everywhere, but it is nowhere.
sentences.chinese: 我到处都检查了，但是哪里都没有。

sentences.english: Be careful next time. Do not forget your things.
sentences.chinese: 下次小心点。别忘了你的东西。

sentences.english: Is this your bag? I found it under the table.
sentences.chinese: 这是你的包吗？我在桌子下面找到它的。

sentences.english: Yes! Thank you! I forgot I put it there.
sentences.chinese: 是的！谢谢你！我忘了我把它放在那里了。

sentences.english: I always lose my keys. I need to be careful.
sentences.chinese: 我总是丢钥匙。我需要小心点。

sentences.english: The last place I saw my phone was on the sofa.
sentences.chinese: 我最后一次看到我的手机是在沙发上。

sentences.english: Look for your glasses. Maybe they are on your head.
sentences.chinese: 找找你的眼镜。也许它们在你头上。

sentences.english: I lost my bag yesterday and looked for it everywhere, but my friend found it in another room behind the door, so now I check every place carefully and never forget where I put my things.
sentences.chinese: 我昨天丢了包，到处找它，但是我的朋友在门后面的另一个房间里找到了它，所以现在我会仔细检查每个地方，再也不会忘记我把东西放在哪里了。

conversation_script.text_en: Help! I lost my bag! I cannot find it anywhere!
conversation_script.text_zh: 救命！我的包丢了！我到处都找不到它！

conversation_script.text_en: Calm down. Where did you last see it?
conversation_script.text_zh: 冷静点。你最后一次在哪里看到它？

conversation_script.text_en: I do not remember. Maybe I left it on the bus.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我不记得了。也许我把它落在公交车上了。

conversation_script.text_en: Did you check your room? Look for it everywhere.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你检查你的房间了吗？到处找找。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, I checked everywhere, but it is nowhere.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，我到处都检查了，但是哪里都没有。

conversation_script.text_en: Wait, did you go to another place today?
conversation_script.text_zh: 等等，你今天去了另一个地方吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Oh! I went to the cafe. Maybe it is still there!
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦！我去了咖啡馆。也许它还在那里！

conversation_script.text_en: Call the cafe. Ask them to check for your bag.
conversation_script.text_zh: 打电话给咖啡馆。让他们检查一下你的包。

conversation_script.text_en: Good idea! I will call now. But wait, what is that under the chair?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好主意！我现在就打。但是等等，椅子下面那个是什么？

conversation_script.text_en: Is it your bag? You forgot you put it there!
conversation_script.text_zh: 是你的包吗？你忘了你把它放在那里了！

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! It is my bag! I am so happy I found it!
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！是我的包！我太高兴找到它了！

conversation_script.text_en: You need to be careful. Do not forget where you put things.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你需要小心点。别忘了你把东西放在哪里。

conversation_script.text_en: I know. I always lose things. Last week I lost my keys.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我知道。我总是丢东西。上周我丢了钥匙。

conversation_script.text_en: And where did you find them?
conversation_script.text_zh: 那你在哪里找到它们的？

conversation_script.text_en: In my bag! Now my bag is here, and I will not lose it again!
conversation_script.text_zh: 在我的包里！现在我的包在这里，我不会再弄丢它了！

conversation_script.text_en: Great! Put it in a safe place, and remember that place!
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了！把它放在一个安全的地方，然后记住那个地方！

sentences.english: The bed is in the center of the room.
The lamp is in the corner, next to the sofa.
sentences.chinese: 台灯在角落里，在沙发旁边。

sentences.english: Your room is very tidy. I like it.
sentences.chinese: 你的房间很整洁。我喜欢它。

sentences.english: My brother's room is always messy.
sentences.chinese: 我弟弟的房间总是凌乱的。

sentences.english: The window is big, so the room is bright.
sentences.chinese: 窗户很大，所以房间很明亮。

sentences.english: There is no light. The room is dark.
This room is empty. There is no furniture.
sentences.chinese: 这个房间是空的。没有家具。

sentences.english: My room is full of books and toys.
sentences.chinese: 我的房间里满是书和玩具。

sentences.english: I want to decorate my room with pictures.
sentences.chinese: 我想用照片装饰我的房间。

sentences.english: What does your room look like?
sentences.chinese: 你的房间看起来什么样？

sentences.english: It looks like a small but cozy space.
sentences.chinese: 它看起来像一个小而温馨的空间。

sentences.english: The desk is in the corner, and the chair is in the center.
sentences.chinese: 书桌在角落里，椅子在中间。

sentences.english: My room is not very spacious, but it is bright and tidy, with a comfortable bed in the center and a small lamp in the corner next to the desk.
sentences.chinese: 我的房间不是很宽敞，但是很明亮整洁，中间有一张舒适的床，角落里的书桌旁边有一盏小台灯。

conversation_script.text_en: Welcome to my home! Come in and see my room.
conversation_script.text_zh: 欢迎来我家！进来看看我的房间。

conversation_script.text_en: Wow! Your room is very spacious and bright!
conversation_script.text_zh: 哇！你的房间很宽敞明亮！

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you! I try to keep it tidy. What does your room look like?
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢！我尽量保持整洁。你的房间看起来什么样？

conversation_script.text_en: My room is small, but it is cozy and comfortable.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我的房间很小，但是很温馨舒适。

conversation_script.text_en: Nice! Where is your bed? In the center?
conversation_script.text_zh: 真好！你的床在哪里？在中间吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, it is in the corner, next to the window.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不，它在角落里，在窗户旁边。

conversation_script.text_en: I see. My bed is in the center, and my desk is in the corner.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我明白了。我的床在中间，我的书桌在角落里。

conversation_script.text_en: Your room is full of nice furniture. Did you decorate it yourself?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你的房间里有很多漂亮的家具。你自己装饰的吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! I put pictures on the wall. They are in every corner.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！我在墙上挂了照片。每个角落都有。

conversation_script.text_en: My room is always messy. My clothes are everywhere.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我的房间总是凌乱的。我的衣服到处都是。

conversation_script.text_en: You need more space. My room is tidy because I have enough space.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你需要更多空间。我的房间整洁是因为我有足够的空间。

conversation_script.text_en: True. When it is dark outside, is your room dark too?
conversation_script.text_zh: 没错。外面天黑的时候，你的房间也暗吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, I have a big lamp in the center. It makes the room bright.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不，我在中间有一盏大灯。它让房间很明亮。

conversation_script.text_en: I want a room like yours! Spacious, tidy, and bright!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我想要一个像你这样的房间！宽敞、整洁又明亮！

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you! But your room is nice too. Small rooms are cozy!
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢！但是你的房间也很好。小房间很温馨！

conversation_script.text_en: You are right! I will decorate my corner and make it look great!
conversation_script.text_zh: 你说得对！我要装饰我的角落，让它看起来棒极了！

sentences.english: I need to search for my remote.
Did you check the drawer in the kitchen?
sentences.chinese: 你检查过厨房的抽屉了吗？

sentences.english: My wallet is not in its usual spot.
sentences.chinese: 我的钱包不在它通常的位置。

sentences.english: The glasses are on the shelf in the closet.
I always put my charger next to the bed.
sentences.chinese: 我总是把充电器放在床旁边。

sentences.english: Someone moved my keys. I cannot find them.
sentences.chinese: 有人移动了我的钥匙。我找不到它们。

sentences.english: Did you borrow my book? Please return it.
sentences.chinese: 你借了我的书吗？请归还它。

sentences.english: Hurry! We need to leave, but I lost my glasses.
sentences.chinese: 快点！我们需要走了，但是我找不到眼镜了。

sentences.english: Search the drawer. Maybe your wallet is there.
sentences.chinese: 搜一下抽屉。也许你的钱包在那里。

sentences.english: I checked the shelf, but the remote is not there.
sentences.chinese: 我检查了架子，但是遥控器不在那里。

sentences.english: Is the charger in the closet or on the desk?
sentences.chinese: 充电器在衣柜里还是在书桌上？

sentences.english: It is in its usual spot, under the shelf.
sentences.chinese: 它在它通常的位置，在架子下面。

sentences.english: I moved your glasses to the drawer. Sorry!
sentences.chinese: 我把你的眼镜移到抽屉里了。对不起！

sentences.english: Return my book to the shelf when you finish it.
sentences.chinese: 你看完书后把它放回架子上。

sentences.english: I always search for my wallet in a hurry, but it is usually in its usual spot in the drawer next to my glasses, not on the shelf in the closet.
sentences.chinese: 我总是匆忙地找我的钱包，但它通常在我眼镜旁边抽屉里的老位置，不在衣柜的架子上。

conversation_script.text_en: Hurry up! We are late! Where are my keys?
conversation_script.text_zh: 快点！我们要迟到了！我的钥匙在哪里？

conversation_script.text_en: Calm down. Did you search the drawer in the kitchen?
conversation_script.text_zh: 冷静点。你搜过厨房的抽屉了吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, but they are not there. Someone moved them!
conversation_script.text_zh: 搜过了，但是不在那里。有人移动了它们！

conversation_script.text_en: Check the shelf in the closet. Maybe you put them there.
conversation_script.text_zh: 检查一下衣柜里的架子。也许你放在那里了。

conversation_script.text_en: No, I never put keys there. Where is my wallet then?
conversation_script.text_zh: 不，我从不把钥匙放在那里。那我的钱包呢？

conversation_script.text_en: Is it in its usual spot? Next to your glasses?
conversation_script.text_zh: 它在它通常的位置吗？在你的眼镜旁边？

conversation_script.text_en: Oh! My glasses are not there either. I need to search everywhere!
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦！我的眼镜也不在那里。我需要到处搜索！

conversation_script.text_en: Wait, did you borrow my charger? I cannot find it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 等等，你借了我的充电器吗？我找不到它了。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, I borrowed it. It is under the shelf in my room.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，我借了。它在我房间架子下面。

conversation_script.text_en: Please return it. I need to charge my phone.
conversation_script.text_zh: 请归还它。我需要给我的手机充电。

conversation_script.text_en: OK, I will. But first, help me find my remote!
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，我会的。但是先帮我找我的遥控器！

conversation_script.text_en: Is it in the drawer next to the bed?
conversation_script.text_zh: 它在床旁边的抽屉里吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, I checked. Oh! It is on the shelf in the closet!
conversation_script.text_zh: 不，我检查过了。哦！它在衣柜的架子上！

conversation_script.text_en: See? You put things in strange places. Now, your keys?
conversation_script.text_zh: 看到了吧？你把东西放在奇怪的地方。现在，你的钥匙呢？

conversation_script.text_en: Found them! They were in my pocket the whole time!
conversation_script.text_zh: 找到了！它们一直在我的口袋里！

conversation_script.text_en: Haha! Next time, put everything in its usual spot!
conversation_script.text_zh: 哈哈！下次，把所有东西都放在它通常的位置！

sentences.chinese: 给我描述一下这张图片。

sentences.english: The cat is sitting on the chair in the photo.
sentences.chinese: 照片里猫正坐在椅子上。

sentences.english: Point to the dog in the picture.
Show me the frame hanging on the wall.
sentences.chinese: 给我看看挂在墙上的相框。

sentences.english: In the background, there is a big tree.
In the foreground, a boy is standing.
sentences.chinese: 在前景中，一个男孩正站着。

sentences.english: The girl is lying on the grass in the picture.
sentences.chinese: 图片里女孩正躺在草地上。

sentences.english: Can you see the detail in the corner?
sentences.chinese: 你能看到角落里的细节吗？

sentences.english: Guess what is behind the door in this photo.
sentences.chinese: 猜猜这张照片里门后面是什么。

sentences.english: The picture shows a house between two hills.
sentences.chinese: 这张图片展示了一座在两座山之间的房子。

sentences.english: Describe where the sun is in this picture.
sentences.chinese: 描述一下这张图片里太阳在哪里。

sentences.english: It is above the clouds in the background.
sentences.chinese: 它在背景中的云层上方。

sentences.english: The book is under the table in the photo.
Point to the bird sitting on the roof.
In this picture, the boy is standing in the foreground next to a dog lying on the grass, while in the background above the hills, the sun is hanging in the sky between two clouds.
sentences.chinese: 在这张图片里，男孩站在前景中一只躺在草地上的狗旁边，而在背景中群山上方，太阳悬挂在天空中的两朵云之间。

conversation_script.text_en: Look at this picture! Can you describe it to me?
conversation_script.text_zh: 看这张图片！你能给我描述一下吗？

conversation_script.text_en: OK! In the foreground, a girl is sitting on a bench.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的！在前景中，一个女孩正坐在长椅上。

conversation_script.text_en: Good! What is in the background?
There is a big house standing between two trees.
conversation_script.text_zh: 有一座大房子矗立在两棵树之间。

conversation_script.text_en: Nice detail! Point to the cat in the photo.
conversation_script.text_zh: 细节很好！指向照片里的猫。

conversation_script.text_en: It is lying on the roof of the house, above the door.
conversation_script.text_zh: 它正躺在房子的屋顶上，在门的上方。

conversation_script.text_en: Wow! I did not see that. What else can you show me?
conversation_script.text_zh: 哇！我没看到那个。你还能给我展示什么？

conversation_script.text_en: Look at the frame hanging on the wall in the picture.
conversation_script.text_zh: 看图片里挂在墙上的相框。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh yes! Inside the frame, there is another small photo.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦是的！相框里面，还有另一张小照片。

conversation_script.text_en: Right! Guess where that small photo was taken.
conversation_script.text_zh: 没错！猜猜那张小照片是在哪里拍的。

conversation_script.text_en: Hmm, there is a beach in the background. Near the sea?
conversation_script.text_zh: 嗯，背景里有海滩。在海边吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! And in the foreground, a boy is standing under an umbrella.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！而且在前景中，一个男孩正站在伞下面。

conversation_script.text_en: I love this picture! Describe one more thing.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我喜欢这张图片！再描述一样东西。

conversation_script.text_en: In the corner, below the bench, there is a small dog sleeping.
conversation_script.text_zh: 在角落里，长椅下面，有一只小狗在睡觉。

conversation_script.text_en: You are so good at this! Every detail is in the right place!
conversation_script.text_zh: 你太擅长这个了！每个细节都在正确的位置！

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you! Now you show me a picture, and I will guess the prepositions!
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢你！现在你给我看一张图片，我来猜方位词！

sentences.english: Go straight ahead for two blocks.
Turn left at the next traffic light.
sentences.chinese: 在下一个红绿灯处向左转。

sentences.english: Cross the street at the crosswalk.
The shop is opposite the bank.
Turn around. You are going the wrong way.
It is on the corner, next to the pharmacy.
sentences.chinese: 它在拐角处，在药店旁边。

sentences.english: Do not miss the second turn on the right.
sentences.chinese: 不要错过右边的第二个转弯。

sentences.english: You will arrive at the park in five minutes.
sentences.chinese: 你将在五分钟后到达公园。

sentences.english: I am lost. Can you show me the direction on the map?
sentences.chinese: 我迷路了。你能在地图上给我指方向吗？

sentences.english: Go straight ahead, then turn right at the first corner.
sentences.chinese: 直走，然后在第一个拐角处向右转。

sentences.english: The hospital is opposite the school, next to the traffic light.
sentences.chinese: 医院在学校对面，在红绿灯旁边。

sentences.english: Cross two blocks, then turn around and go back.
sentences.chinese: 穿过两个街区，然后转身往回走。

sentences.english: Do not turn left. Go straight ahead to the crosswalk.
sentences.chinese: 不要向左转。直走到人行横道。

sentences.english: I arrived at the shop, but it is on the opposite side of the street.
sentences.chinese: 我到了商店，但是它在街道的另一边。

sentences.english: Go straight ahead for three blocks, turn left at the second traffic light, cross the street at the crosswalk, and the park is on the corner opposite the bank, next to the pharmacy.
sentences.chinese: 直走三个街区，在第二个红绿灯处向左转，在人行横道处过马路，公园就在银行对面、药店旁边的拐角处。

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, I am lost. Can you help me find the park?
conversation_script.text_zh: 打扰一下，我迷路了。你能帮我找到公园吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure! Go straight ahead for two blocks.
OK, then what? Turn left or right?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，然后呢？向左转还是向右转？

conversation_script.text_en: Turn left at the traffic light. Do not miss it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 在红绿灯处向左转。别错过了。

conversation_script.text_en: Got it. Then do I cross the street?
conversation_script.text_zh: 明白了。然后我要过马路吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, cross at the crosswalk. It is safer there.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，在人行横道处过马路。那里更安全。

conversation_script.text_en: OK. Is the park on this side or the opposite side?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的。公园在这边还是对面？

conversation_script.text_en: It is on the corner, next to the pharmacy. You will see it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 它在拐角处，在药店旁边。你会看到的。

conversation_script.text_en: Wait, I think I took the wrong turn. Should I turn around?
conversation_script.text_zh: 等等，我觉得我转错弯了。我应该转身吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, turn around and go back to the first corner.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，转身回到第一个拐角处。

conversation_script.text_en: Now I see the traffic light. I turn left here?
conversation_script.text_zh: 现在我看到红绿灯了。我在这里向左转吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Exactly! Then go straight ahead. You will arrive soon.
conversation_script.text_zh: 没错！然后直走。你很快就到了。

conversation_script.text_en: I see the pharmacy! The park is next to it, right?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我看到药店了！公园在它旁边，对吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, on the corner opposite the bank. You found it!
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，在银行对面的拐角处。你找到了！

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you so much! I need a map. I always get lost!
conversation_script.text_zh: 非常感谢！我需要一个地图。我总是迷路！

conversation_script.text_en: Haha, no problem! Next time, just go straight and do not turn around!
conversation_script.text_zh: 哈哈，没问题！下次，直走别转身就行了！

sentences.english: Go past the gas station and turn left.
sentences.chinese: 经过加油站然后向左转。

sentences.english: Continue straight until you see the bakery.
sentences.chinese: 继续直走直到你看到面包店。

sentences.english: Turn right at the second roundabout.
sentences.chinese: 在第二个环岛处向右转。

sentences.english: Do not stop. Go past the post office.
Follow the signpost until you reach the landmark.
sentences.chinese: 跟随路标直到你到达地标。

sentences.english: Go past the bakery, then turn around the corner.
sentences.chinese: 经过面包店，然后在拐角处转弯。

sentences.english: Turn left at the first stop sign.
sentences.chinese: 在第一个停车标志处向左转。

sentences.english: Continue past the park until the traffic light.
sentences.chinese: 继续经过公园直到红绿灯处。

sentences.english: Go past two shops, then turn right.
sentences.chinese: 经过两家商店，然后向右转。
